news.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico say their journalists have been denied access to the White House
news.summary: The White House denied CNN, MS NOW and Politico journalists access to its grounds Saturday, the networks announced, a day after President Trump said he was banning them from the premises after accusing them of producing “purposefully negative stories.” “Earlier this morning MS NOW journalists were denied access to the White House grounds.
